page_title: FIO 1-1 ATA | Fiorentina v Atalanta 22/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+1' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) sends a long ball in, but Oliver Christensen comfortably gathers the ball.
90+1' 3 additional min. will be played.
88' Mario Perri blows his whistle and it's Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
87' Paolo Vanoli has decided to make a change. Luca Lezzerini (Fiorentina) replaces Oliver Christensen.
86' Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
85' A cross from the by-line finds Giovanni Fabbian (Fiorentina) unmarked on the penalty spot, but he is unable to find the target and sends his header well wide of the left post.
82' 1 - 1 This is definitely not what Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) wanted. Attempting to intercept an offensive pass, he scored an own goal and made it 1:1.
81' Kamaldeen Sulemana comes off the pitch to be replaced by Dominic Vavassori (Atalanta).
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marten de Roon departs the field of play to be replaced by Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta).
80' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) takes the corner kick, but Marco Sportiello reads it well and stops the effort.

80' Giovanni Fabbian (Fiorentina) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting corner and steers his header into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him. It will be a corner kick for Fiorentina.
79' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
79' Dodo (Fiorentina) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Fiorentina have a corner.
77' Atalanta take a short corner kick.

77' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) weaves through the defence with ease and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score with his strike towards the bottom right corner as Oliver Christensen produces a good save. The referee signals a corner kick to Atalanta.
76' Paolo Vanoli prepares a substitution. Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) is replaced by Manor Solomon.
76' The referee signals a substitution. Luis Balbo (Fiorentina) is brought on as a substitute for Robin Gosens.
72' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
69' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
67' Substitution. Daniele Rugani (Fiorentina) is replaced by Marin Pongracic.
67' Here is a change. Marco Brescianini (Fiorentina) is going off and Paolo Vanoli gives the last tactical orders to Cher Ndour.
67' The referee allows time for a substitution. Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) will be replaced by Berat Djimsiti.
62' Raffaele Palladino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Charles De Ketelaere replacing Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta).
62' Fiorentina work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

61' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top left corner only for Marco Sportiello to dive and make a save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Fiorentina.
61' It seemed like Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
60' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) was quite harsh and Mario Perri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
58' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atalanta.
57' Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) latches on to an accurate pass into the box and immediately unleashes a low shot goalwards. His effort is well saved by the keeper.
55' Dodo (Fiorentina) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Marco Sportiello comes off his line to intercept.
52' A quickly taken corner by Atalanta.

52' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

51' Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Oliver Christensen makes a great save to stop his effort.
47' Yellow card. Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
47' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
46' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) comes on the pitch for Raoul Bellanova.
46' Mario Perri blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.

43' Giovanni Fabbian (Fiorentina) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball goes well wide of the right post!
39' 1 - 0 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Marco Brescianini finds Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball inside the left post. 1:0.
38' The foul by Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) was seen by Mario Perri who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
36' The free kick is taken by Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta), but ball is cleared.
36' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
34' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
32' Poor challenge! Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) is penalised for tripping and Mario Perri blows his whistle.
30' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
23' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is penalised for a foul. Mario Perri had a clear view and blows his whistle.
20' That was close by Marten de Roon (Atalanta)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.

20' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) releases a powerful first-time effort from the edge of the box which goes in the direction of the left-hand post, but the keeper leaps like a salmon to deny him. Excellent goalkeeping!
19' Yunus Musah (Atalanta) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the left side of the goal, but Oliver Christensen is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
17' Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
15' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) receives a precise pass outside the penalty area and strikes the ball goalwards. His attempt only finds one of his teammates, though, and ricochets away off him.
11' Giovanni Fabbian (Fiorentina) commits a foul and Mario Perri immediately signals a free kick.
9' The linesman signals that Marco Brescianini (Fiorentina) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
6' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

5' A sweet pass finds Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the left side of the goal. Oliver Christensen is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
3' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
3' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Fiorentina are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

1' A cross by Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Atalanta will take the kick-off.
Mario Perri will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
